nextPage
set pageNumber = 1
set totalClrBalAmt = 0
set totalDepAmt = 0
set localyears = strToNum localYearsToAdd

print "ACCOUNT BALANCE DETAILS REPORT" center size 132
execute pageHdr
nextline

####################################################################
AFTERBREAKOF schmCode
####################################################################

	ordByCustIdFlg != "Y" and 
	ordByAcctIdFlg != "Y" and 
	ordByStatusFlg != "Y" and 
	ordByMatDtFlg != "Y" )
begin
	nextline
	separatorline
	print "TOTAL" column 50
    if(maskFlg = "Y")
	begin
	print  maskingDesc  size 20 column 71
	print  maskingDesc  size 20 column 92
	end
	else
	begin
    print totalDepAmt autocomma size 20 column 93 leftjustify
	print totalClrBalAmt autocomma size 20 column 113 leftjustify
    end
    separatorline
	set totalDepAmt = 0
	set totalClrBalAmt = 0
	nextPage

if(acctClsFlg="Y" and locToClsDate !=0 and locPeriodDiff2 > 0 )

	nextline

	print custId column 18 
	print custName column 18 size 32  
	set localdate = stringToDate  openEffectiveDate
	set localdate = periodAdd localdate localyears Y
	print localdate DateFormat "" column 50

	print depPerInMths column 62 precision 0
	print depPerInDays column 66 precision 0

	set localdate = stringToDate  matDate
	set localdate = periodAdd localdate localyears Y
	print localdate DateFormat "" column 71

	set maskingDesc = "*******"
	if (crncyCode != "")
		begin
			print crncyCode column 85
		end
	else
		begin
			print acctCrncyCode column 85 
		end
	if(maskFlg = "Y") 
		begin 
			print  maskingDesc  size 20 column 93 
			print  maskingDesc  size 20 column 113 
		end
	else 
		begin 
			print depAmount autocomma size 20 column 93 leftjustify
			set header_remark = runscript "acctbal.scr" "acctId" "rate|AcPrfCR|nrmlpcntcr"

	    end
	print depStatus column 122
	print safeCustodyFlg column 124
	print acctClsFlg column 126
	print lienFlg column 128
	print splCatInd column 130
	print AcPrfCR  format "###.##" column 130 
	set totalDepAmt = totalDepAmt + depAmount
end

# This procedure print the lines fetched from docTextFields in proper format as they contain

PROCEDURE printTextFormat
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set locPos = getPos locText "`"
set locTextLen = strlen locText
if(locPos != 0)
begin
#	print "X : "
#	print locText
#	print " || "
	set locPos1 = locPos - 1
	set locPos2 = locPos + 1
	set locTempText = substr locText 1 locPos1
	set locText = substr locText locPos2 locTextLen
	set locNextLine = "Y"
	print locTempText
	nextLine
	execute printTextFormat
end
else
begin
#	print "Z : "
#	print locText
#	print " || "
	if(locText != "")
	begin
		print locText
		set locNextLine = "N"
#		print locNextLine
	end
end

PROCEDURE reqireddate
BEGIN
    set dd=substr indate 1,3
set mm=substr indate 4,2
    set yyyy= substr indate 6,5

    if mm="01"
begin
        set mon="JAN"
    end
    if mm="02"
    begin
        set mon="FEB"
    end
    if mm="03"
    begin
        set mon="MAR"
    end
    if mm="04"
    begin
        set mon="APR"
    end
    if mm="05"
    begin
        set mon="MAY"
    end
    if mm="06"
    begin
        set mon="JUN"
    end
    if mm="07"
    begin
        set mon="JUL"
    end
    if mm="08"
    begin
        set mon="AUG"
    end
    if mm="09"
    begin
        set mon="SEP"
    end
   if mm="10"
    begin
        set mon="OCT"
    end
    if mm="11"
    begin
        set mon="NOV"
    end
    if mm="12"
    begin
        set mon="DEC"
    end

set formattedate=strcat dd MON
set formattedate= strcat formattedate yyyy

END

PROCEDURE reqireddate
BEGIN
	set dd=substr indate 1,3
	set mm=substr indate 4,2
	set yyyy= substr indate 6,5

	if mm="01"
	begin
		set mon="JAN"
	end
	if mm="02"
	begin
		set mon="FEB"
	end
	if mm="03"
	begin
		set mon="MAR"
	end
	if mm="04"
	begin
		set mon="APR"
	end
	if mm="05"
	begin
		set mon="MAY"
	end
	if mm="06"
	begin
		set mon="JUN"
	end
	if mm="07"
	begin
		set mon="JUL"
	end
	if mm="08"
	begin
		set mon="AUG"
	end
	if mm="09"
	begin
		set mon="SEP"
	end
	if mm="10"
	begin
		set mon="OCT"
	end
	if mm="11"
	begin
		set mon="NOV"
	end
	if mm="12"
	begin
		set mon="DEC"
	end

set formattedate=strcat dd MON
set formattedate= strcat formattedate yyyy

END
